events.name: The Three Birds Trial

remembers.notice: You carry The Still Wing. The ice-blue crest burns a little brighter for you: it will give you a hint.
You carry The Thundercloud. The yellow crest burns a little brighter for you: it will give you a hint.
You carry The Spring Fire. The red crest burns a little brighter for you: it will give you a hint.

events.intro:
At dusk, three crests light up on a far cliff: ice-blue, yellow, red.

Old Guide: "They were never three birds. They were three answers to the same question."
Old Guide: "What do you do when the weather turns on you?"
Old Guide: "One of them will ask you that. Just one. The other two will be jealous."

success.text: You climb toward the ice-blue crest.
You climb toward the yellow crest.
You climb toward the red crest.
Old Guide: "They'll still be there."

remembers.notice: You carry The Still Wing. The ice-blue crest burns a little brighter for you: it will give you a hint.
You carry The Thundercloud. The yellow crest burns a little brighter for you: it will give you a hint.
You carry The Spring Fire. The red crest burns a little brighter for you: it will give you a hint.

events.intro: The cliff again. The crests you have not answered are still lit. The Old Guide is sitting where you left him.

success.text: You climb toward the ice-blue crest.

You climb toward the red crest.
Old Guide: "They'll still be there."

events.name: The Three Birds Trial: Frozen Sky
events.intro:
Snow falls from a clear summer sky.

Articuno's cry, as a line on the screen: Stand still.
Survive six turns of the blizzard without a damaging move. Status moves and switching are allowed.

success.text: The blizzard comes down on you.
It lets you down the mountain unharmed. The ice-blue crest goes dark.

events.name: The Three Birds Trial: Thunder Roost 1
events.intro:
Lightning strikes one hill forty times a night.

A storm chaser on the slope: "It wants whoever gets to the top during the storm. Not after. During."
Keep a Ground-type in front. Four stretches to the top.

branches.text: The lightning hits the ground beside you, not you. Your Ground-type in front drinks it up.

success.text: The bolt hits your lead. Strike.

events.name: The Three Birds Trial: Thunder Roost 2
events.intro: Stretch 2 of the climb. The air tastes of metal.

branches.text: The lightning hits the ground beside you, not you. Your Ground-type in front drinks it up.

success.text: The bolt hits your lead. Strike.

success.text: The bolt hits your lead. Strike.

events.name: The Three Birds Trial: The Top
events.intro: The top of the hill, in the storm. Zapdos turns to see who arrived.

branches.text: You arrive half-paralysed and late. It flies off without looking twice. The yellow crest goes dark.

success.text: It looks at you a long time, and lands.

events.name: The Three Birds Trial: Ember Peak 1
events.intro:
Carry an ember from the base of the volcano to the rim.

A pilgrim at the base, handing you a clay bowl: "Don't let it go out. It's the only thing it'll accept."

success.text: The ember holds.

failure.text: The wind takes the flame down to a red spark.

events.name: The Three Birds Trial: Ember Peak 2
events.intro: Stretch 2. The wind comes round the mountain.

success.text: The ember holds.

failure.text: The wind takes the flame down to a red spark.

events.intro: Stretch 3. The wind comes round the mountain.

success.text: The ember holds.

failure.text: The wind takes the flame down to a red spark.

events.intro: Stretch 4. The wind comes round the mountain.

success.text: The ember holds.

failure.text: The wind takes the flame down to a red spark.

events.name: The Three Birds Trial: The Rim
events.intro: The rim of the volcano. You hold out the bowl.

branches.text: It is ash. Moltres flies off. The red crest goes dark.
It went out on the way up and nobody could relight it. Moltres flies off. The red crest goes dark.
It went out once, and your Fire-type lit it again. It is still burning. Moltres lands.

success.text: It is still burning. Moltres lands.

events.name: The Three Birds Trial: Articuno Lands

remembers.notice: Articuno knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Articuno.

success.text: Articuno lowers its head and lets you touch its feathers. It comes with you.

events.intro: Articuno lands in front of you. It offers a battle.

success.text: Articuno rises.
It bows back, and flies.

events.name: The Three Birds Trial: The Jealous One
events.intro: Articuno arrives uninvited, furious. It did not ask you anything, and you answered the other two.

success.text: It attacks at once.

win.text: The three birds were seen flying together over the next region.

events.name: Ho-Oh and the Rainbow Feather
events.intro:
A feather falls from a clear sky. It is every colour at once, and warm.

A child, pointing: "That's Ho-Oh's. My grandad said it drops one on whoever it's watching."
The child: "He also said it only lands for people who go back."
Your lead looks up at the sky for a long moment.

success.text: You keep it in your bag. Three burnt footprints lead away across the region, each somewhere something was lost.
The child holds it up to the sun. When you look back, there is a second feather at your feet.

events.name: Ho-Oh and the Rainbow Feather: The Burned House
events.intro:
A burnt footprint leads to a burned house.

A woman: "We got everyone out. Except the Growlithe. It went back in for the kits."

success.text: You carry beams until dark. On the step, someone has left a bowl of water, and a Growlithe-sized space beside it.
You walk on. Behind you, the footprint stays burnt into the ground.

events.name: Ho-Oh and the Rainbow Feather: The Grave
events.intro:
A burnt footprint leads to a grave on a hill.

A boy: "I don't know how to say goodbye to it."

success.text: You sit with him. Neither of you says anything for a long time. Then he says goodbye, and it is enough.
You walk on. Behind you, the footprint stays burnt into the ground.

events.name: Ho-Oh and the Rainbow Feather: The Closed Centre
events.intro:
A burnt footprint leads to a Pokémon Centre with its shutters half down.

The nurse, packing: "No one comes this way any more."

success.text: It costs you a node of walking, town to town, telling people. By the time you are done, the shutters are up again.
You walk on. Behind you, the footprint stays burnt into the ground.

events.name: Ho-Oh and the Rainbow Feather: The Bell Tower

remembers.notice: Ho-Oh knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Ho-Oh.

success.text: Ho-Oh lands in front of you, not on the roof. It lets you put your hand on its neck. It comes.

events.intro: The Bell Tower.

branches.text:
With all three helped, the bells ring by themselves. Ho-Oh lands on the roof. It does not look at you. It looks at your party.
Behind you, something stands up: nothing you lost is there, so Ho-Oh simply waits.
A bell rings, once. Ho-Oh circles the tower and flies on.

success.text: The bells do not ring. The feather in your bag goes grey.

events.name: Ho-Oh and the Rainbow Feather: On the Roof
events.intro: Ho-Oh waits on the roof of the Bell Tower, burning gently.

success.text: It rises into the sky and turns.
You thank it. It bows its head and leaves a pinch of ash glowing in the gutter: Sacred Ash.

effects.text: Ho-Oh landed on the Bell Tower for you, and you thanked it.

events.name: Lugia Under the Whirl
events.intro:
A whirlpool swallows a fishing boat in a calm sea. The fisherman is spat out onto the rocks. A silver feather floats where the boat went down.

Fisherman, coughing: "It put me back. It took the boat and it put me back."
Fisherman: "There's a song the old women used to sing at the fourth island. Nobody goes there now. I can't remember the words."
Fisherman: "I remember three bits of it. Each one on a different island."

success.text: Four islands on the horizon. Three whirlpools turning.
You help him up the beach. The whirlpools keep turning.

events.name: Lugia Under the Whirl: Island 1

remembers.intro: Island 1. There is no whirlpool. The sea is silent, and the song fragment is simply lying on the rocks.

success.text: A few words of an old song, scratched into a shell.

events.intro: Island 1. A whirlpool turns between you and the fragment of the song.

success.text: Something rises out of the whirl.
You lose a node waiting. Then the whirlpool slows, and you row across.
You call to Articuno. Far off, a cry. The whirlpool stops.

events.name: Lugia Under the Whirl: Island 2

remembers.intro: Island 2. There is no whirlpool. The sea is silent, and the song fragment is simply lying on the rocks.

success.text: A few words of an old song, scratched into a shell.

events.intro: Island 2. A whirlpool turns between you and the fragment of the song.

success.text: Something rises out of the whirl.
You lose a node waiting. Then the whirlpool slows, and you row across.
You call to Zapdos. Far off, a cry. The whirlpool stops.

events.name: Lugia Under the Whirl: Island 3

remembers.intro: Island 3. There is no whirlpool. The sea is silent, and the song fragment is simply lying on the rocks.

success.text: A few words of an old song, scratched into a shell.

events.intro: Island 3. A whirlpool turns between you and the fragment of the song.

success.text: Something rises out of the whirl.
You lose a node waiting. Then the whirlpool slows, and you row across.
You call to Moltres. Far off, a cry. The whirlpool stops.

events.name: Lugia Under the Whirl: The Fourth Island

remembers.notice: Lugia knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Lugia.

success.text: Lugia rises with the island under it, and lowers its head to you. It does not want a battle. It offers itself.

events.intro:
Island 4 is empty and quiet. Your Pokémon sing the three fragments in order. The sea goes flat.
Something very large rises under the island, and the island rises with it.

Lugia, as a subtitle to its cry: Who taught you that?

success.text: Lugia carries you to the fisherman's village and sets you down. Then it offers a battle.
Lugia battles at once, testing you.
Lugia lowers its head. The sea stays calm for the battle.

events.name: The Lab at the End of the Cave
events.intro:
A cave the locals do not enter. A hum under it. As you step in, a voice inside your head:

Mewtwo: "Do not come in."

A note pinned to the wall, in a scientist's hand: "Day 1. It is beautiful. It opened its eyes and looked at me."
Mewtwo: "You read that. Now answer me. What are you for?"

success.text: Mewtwo: "...Honest. Come down."

branches.text: Mewtwo: "You have beaten people who wanted it more. That is true, at least."

success.text: Mewtwo: "We will see." The hum deepens.

branches.text: Mewtwo: "One of them fell, not long ago, in your care. Try again on the way down."

success.text: Mewtwo: "Is that so." It looks at your party, one by one.
The hum follows you out, and stops at the cave mouth.

events.name: The Lab at the End of the Cave: The Flooded Hall
events.intro:
The flooded hall. A note on a floating clipboard: "Day 40. It asked me why. I did not have an answer it would accept."

Mewtwo: "And them? What are your Pokémon for?"

success.text: Mewtwo: "Then they are like me."
Mewtwo is quiet a long time.
Mewtwo asks them. You do not hear what they say. It does.

events.name: The Lab at the End of the Cave: The Lab
events.intro:
The lab. The last note: "Day 41." It is blank except for a handprint in something dark.

Mewtwo: "Last question. If someone made you, without asking, for something you did not choose: would you forgive them?"

success.text: Mewtwo: "Easily said."
Mewtwo: "Easily said."
Mewtwo: "So would I."

events.name: The Lab at the End of the Cave: The Tanks
events.intro: Mewtwo, among broken tanks.

branches.text: Mewtwo: "You did not lie to me. That is rare."
Mewtwo: "Some of that was true." It battles to see what you are.

success.text: Mewtwo: "Everyone who has come here has lied to me." It battles at full strength.

events.name: The Lab at the End of the Cave: Rare
events.intro: Mewtwo waits. For once, it is asking.

success.text: Mewtwo: "Then show me."
Mewtwo: "...Thank you." It is gone. Later, during the Champion battle, you will see it on a cliff, watching.

effects.text: You left Mewtwo in peace. It had never been told the truth before.

events.name: The Sky and the Sea
events.intro:
Two towns, one road apart. In one the sea is in the streets. In the other the wells are steaming.

Archie, on the harbour wall, delighted: "Look at it! It's coming back! The sea's coming back where it belongs!"
Maxie, two towns over, mopping his brow: "More land. Room for everyone. You do see that? Room."
A meteorologist, to nobody: "They're both going to kill everyone."

choices.label: Find out where their Orbs are.

success.text: Each team holds an Orb. Each team has a base. The meteorologist gives you both addresses.
The sea keeps rising in one town, and the wells keep steaming in the other.

events.name: The Sky and the Sea: Archie's Base
events.intro: Archie's base. The Orb glows in a case in the middle of the room.

success.text: Grunts everywhere.
Archie: "The sea made everything. It's owed. You've seen what the land does to it." He is partly right. Nothing changes.
Officer Jenny raids the base. The Orb is moved, not taken.

events.name: The Sky and the Sea: Maxie's Base
events.intro: Maxie's base. The Orb glows in a case in the middle of the room.

success.text: Grunts everywhere.
Maxie: "People are crammed onto the coasts. More land is room to live. Room. It's that simple." He is partly right. Nothing changes.
Officer Jenny raids the base. The Orb is moved, not taken.

events.name: The Sky and the Sea: The Sky Pillar
events.intro: The Sky Pillar: five crumbling floors.

success.text:
You climb all five floors. At the top, the green dragon is asleep, coiled round the pillar three times.
The meteorologist, who followed: "If you wake it, it won't take a side. That's the point of it."

failure.text: A floor gives way. You land hard, two floors down, and climb back out.

choices.label: Climb, with a Flying-type to catch you.

success.text: A floor gives way and your Flying-type catches you. You try again. At the top, the green dragon is asleep, coiled round the pillar three times.

failure.text: Even with wings under you, it is too far. You come down.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Sky and the Sea: The Titans

remembers.notice:
You call both leaders onto the field.
Archie: "...That's my town under there."
Maxie: "And mine."
They stop. The titans are easier to calm.

success.text: You stand in the flood and the steam and try to reach Kyogre.
You stand in the flood and the steam and try to reach Groudon.

events.intro: Both titans wake (or one, if an Orb was taken). The arena floods and dries in turns.

success.text: You stand in the flood and the steam and try to reach Kyogre.
You stand in the flood and the steam and try to reach Groudon.
Rayquaza comes down out of the sky, and the fight stops. Then it turns to you.

events.name: The Eon Siblings
events.intro:
A shimmer crosses the sky. Something flies low over you and waits, a little ahead, as if to be followed.

In the canal city, a girl at a fruit stall, who is also, you notice, sitting on a bench across the canal: "You followed. Good."
The girl: "There are people here with a machine that sees through things. They'll find the garden."
The girl: "My brother says not to trust you. I'm not very good at listening to him."

success.text: She leads you into the canals.
The shimmer follows you to the edge of town, then turns back.

events.name: The Eon Siblings: Bridge 1
events.intro: Bridge 1. The collectors' machine operators are on it, scanning the canal.

success.text: They turn the machine on you.
You run. They chase you. The girl gets through.
One hard hit and the lens cracks across.

events.name: The Eon Siblings: Bridge 2
events.intro: Bridge 2. The collectors' machine operators are on it, scanning the canal.

success.text: They turn the machine on you.
You run. They chase you. The girl gets through.
One hard hit and the lens cracks across.

events.name: The Eon Siblings: Bridge 3
events.intro: Bridge 3. The collectors' machine operators are on it, scanning the canal.

success.text: They turn the machine on you.
You run. They chase you. The girl gets through.
One hard hit and the lens cracks across.

events.name: The Eon Siblings: The Garden

remembers.intro: The collectors never find the garden at all. There is no overload. The siblings come down together and thank you.

success.text: She comes down to meet you, playful.
He comes down to meet you, serious.

remembers.notice: You carry The Blue Mind. The jewel at the garden's heart answers you.

success.text: The Rite is spent. The water stops. Both live.

events.intro:
The collectors' machine overloads. The canals start to rise.

Latios, appearing beside his sister, a subtitle under his cry: Get her out.
Latias: No.

success.text: Six turns holding back the water with him.
You pull her out of the garden. Latios gives everything to hold the water back. When it is over, there is a new jewel at the garden's heart.

events.name: The Eon Siblings: Both
events.intro: Both siblings follow you out of the city. One of them could come with you. The other will visit.

success.text: She comes down to meet you, playful.
He comes down to meet you, serious.
They circle you once and go home together. The girl gives you a ticket stamped with a sea you have never seen: the Eon Ticket.

events.name: The Eon Siblings: The Jewel
events.intro: Latias stays in the city. She sits on a bench by the canal, a girl alone. She gives you a ticket stamped with a sea you have never seen.

success.text: The Eon Ticket.

effects.text: Latios became the canal city's jewel. Latias stayed behind.

events.name: The Sealed Braille Door: Regirock
events.intro:
A door covered in raised dots, in a cliff. An old man is sitting beside it, eating.

Old man: "It's writing. For people who can't see. My mother taught me."
Old man, running his fingers along it: "It says: 'Bring the one who is last, and wait.'"
Old man: "I've been trying to work out what it means for forty years. I think it wants patience. I haven't got any."

success.text: You put the smallest one in front and wait, one long breath. The door grinds open. Regirock is inside, asleep on its feet. It wakes, and follows you out. The keystone in the wall comes loose in your hand.
The door bursts. Regirock comes out at full anger.
He tries. He fails. He is glad to have been left to.

events.name: The Sealed Braille Door: Regice
events.intro:
A door covered in raised dots, in a cliff. An old man is sitting beside it, eating.

Old man: "It's writing. For people who can't see. My mother taught me."
Old man, running his fingers along it: "It says: 'Be silent in the cold.'"
Old man: "I've been trying to work out what it means for forty years. I think it wants patience. I haven't got any."

success.text: Two turns of nothing but your own breath freezing. The door grinds open. Regice is inside, asleep on its feet. It wakes, and follows you out. The keystone in the wall comes loose in your hand.
The door bursts. Regice comes out at full anger.
He tries. He fails. He is glad to have been left to.

events.name: The Sealed Braille Door: Registeel
events.intro:
A door covered in raised dots, in a cliff. An old man is sitting beside it, eating.

Old man: "It's writing. For people who can't see. My mother taught me."
Old man, running his fingers along it: "It says: 'Carry what does not rust.'"
Old man: "I've been trying to work out what it means for forty years. I think it wants patience. I haven't got any."

success.text: Your Steel-type walks in with empty hands. The door grinds open. Registeel is inside, asleep on its feet. It wakes, and follows you out. The keystone in the wall comes loose in your hand.
The door bursts. Registeel comes out at full anger.
He tries. He fails. He is glad to have been left to.

events.name: The Sealed Braille Door: Regieleki
events.intro:
A door covered in raised dots, in a cliff. An old man is sitting beside it, eating.

Old man: "It's writing. For people who can't see. My mother taught me."
Old man, running his fingers along it: "It says: 'Run without stopping.'"
Old man: "I've been trying to work out what it means for forty years. I think it wants patience. I haven't got any."

success.text: Three nodes at a run. At the end, the door is open. Regieleki is inside, asleep on its feet. It wakes, and follows you out. The keystone in the wall comes loose in your hand.
The door bursts. Regieleki comes out at full anger.
He tries. He fails. He is glad to have been left to.

events.name: The Sealed Braille Door: Regidrago
events.intro:
A door covered in raised dots, in a cliff. An old man is sitting beside it, eating.

Old man: "It's writing. For people who can't see. My mother taught me."
Old man, running his fingers along it: "It says: 'Bring what is unfinished.'"
Old man: "I've been trying to work out what it means for forty years. I think it wants patience. I haven't got any."

success.text: It sniffs the young one in front of you, and the door grinds open. Regidrago is inside, asleep on its feet. It wakes, and follows you out. The keystone in the wall comes loose in your hand.
The door bursts. Regidrago comes out at full anger.
He tries. He fails. He is glad to have been left to.

events.name: The Sealed Braille Door: The Meadow

remembers.notice: The one you forced will not lie down beside it.

events.intro:
With four keystones, a quiet meadow. Regigigas asleep among the four.

The old man, who has come along, out of breath: "That's the one who made them. It towed the land here with ropes."
Regigigas does not wake.

success.text: It wakes slowly, at half strength for the first turns, and battles.

branches.text: The Regis lie down beside it. Regigigas opens one eye at you, and closes it. You carry The Colossus: its Rite is stronger now.

success.text: The Regis lie down beside it. The meadow is warm and quiet. You rest there.
The Regis you brought step forward. Regigigas wakes, and does not battle. It offers to come.

effects.text: Regigigas woke in the meadow and came with you.
